name: Fallback
description: Two tries on the cheap reader, then the careful one with the same inputs.

careful-reader.description: Answers a customer question from the product notes, slowly and carefully.
careful-reader.instructions:
Read the whole of the product notes before answering. Quote the passage the
answer rests on. If the notes do not answer the question, say exactly what is
missing.

needs.because: this agent only sees the questions the quick reader could not answer

quick-reader.description: Answers a customer question from the product notes, quickly.
quick-reader.instructions:
Answer the customer's question from the product notes you are given. If the
notes do not answer it, say so in one sentence rather than guessing.

checked-by.because: a hedge is not an answer the customer can act on

needs.because: most questions are answered by one passage of the notes

answer.description: Answer one customer question, cheaply when possible and carefully when not.
